architecture.meaning: Predict expected adverse30m path magnitude; lower predicted severity admits Entry. Opportunity remains Frozen Selector responsibility. Not expected PnL, tail probability or executable quality proof.
architecture.rationale: One scalar continuous severity model uses all adverse levels, not only10 extreme tails. No Opportunity×Risk product or duplicate opportunity target.

targetAlternatives.reason: Existing label lineage over1828 candidates; uses mild/moderate/severe adverse paths; independent of EXIT decisions; risk objective linked to portfolio through frozen downstream gates

trainingRows.fitEligible: Training-fold rows with complete D30 and finite mandatory ridgeScore; optional price-path missingness handled as below. No v1 ENTER/portfolio acceptance filter.
trainingRows.weights: For S training symbols, d_s represented training symbol-sessions of symbol s, n_sd eligible rows in symbol-session: w_i=1/(S*d_s*n_sd). Sum_i w_i=1. Recompute on each actual fitting prefix, after label/input eligibility and any held-symbol exclusion.
trainingRows.weightRole: Equal total symbol mass; equal sessions within symbol; repeated observations split that session mass. All IDs follow same formula; symbols never predictors.

features.pitRule: Prefix timestamps/availableAt<=decision, exact required completed5m slots, same session; no previous-session OHLC substitution, future recovery/MFE/MAE/EXIT/PnL/symbol ID prohibited. Historical formula causality is conditional, not full pipeline PIT certification.

missing.scope: Only momentum3 andpullback6; no volume/VWAP input or imputation. Original missing reason retained.
missing.median: Observed finite feature values in actual eligible FIT rows only, weighted by training w_i and renormalized over observed. Sort value theneventId; choose smallest observed value whose cumulative weight>=0.5. No outcome value enters median; no evaluation/past-calibration labels/features in fitted statistics.
missing.sourceMapping: AVAILABLE requires finite valid original value; other original missing statuses map to null+mask1. Nonfinite value falsely taggedAVAILABLE is data integrity failure, not silently imputed.
missing.invalidMandatory: INPUT_INVALID => SKIP_THIS_DECISION; whole invalid fit/source contract fails before fit
missing.unseenMissingBit: If evaluation mask bit1 was never present in that feature training rows, UNSUPPORTED_MISSING_STATE => SKIP_THIS_DECISION; no fallback v1 or fabricated value
missing.scaling: After imputation, weighted training mean and population std of3 raw predictors. Standardize those3 only. Zero/nonfinite std => FIT_FAILED, no silent column drop. Two flags stay0/1 and are not standardized. No percentile clipping. Save exact median/mean/std/mask support with each model.

model.lambdaRationale: Unit regularization relative to weighted-mean loss on standardized raw inputs; simple stability prior independent of event count and P0/v2 performance. No lambda comparison. Flags are also penalized.
model.determinism: Stable sessionDate/decisionTimestamp/symbol/eventId order, fixed numeric dtype and thread env; no randomness, no shuffling/GPU. Identical pinned runtime must reproduce model/prediction hashes; cross-runtime comparison tolerance separately disclosed.
model.supportRationale: At least p+2 labelled rows for p=5 predictors and2 symbols are numerical guards, NOT statistical sufficiency. Each raw predictor needs positive variance and at least2 observed values.
model.failure: Nonfinite input/parameters/objective, solver exception, residualInf>1e-10*(1+rhsInf), insufficient support or missing statistics => FIT_FAILED_NO_MODEL_NO_FALLBACK. No automatic alternative model.
model.nonnegativeReadout: Dhat=max(0,b+z@beta). Projection onto physical adverse magnitude domain, NOT percentile clipping or calibrated tail probability. Raw linear output retained for audit.

cv.thresholdSelection: Inner calibration only; last ceil(n_train/4) sessions of outer training prefix, model/imputer/scaler fit earlier floor(3*n_train/4). Then freeze tau, refit same family on entire outer training prefix, evaluate next15 whole sessions. No outer outcomes for tau.
cv.ratioRationale: Fixed3:1 inner fit/calibration split, no date search; outer chronology inherited v1 session blocks. Small early calibration explicitly may be inconclusive.
cv.purge: Remove FIT row if [decision,labelEnd] intersects any calibration/evaluation observation window in same symbol; require labelAvailableAt strictly before next block start. Whole-day blocks and same-session30m labels normally make overlap empty. No overnight or cross-session fill.
cv.comparisonWindows: All76/3800 remain inventory. Primary nested gate uses same60 evaluation dates/3000 candidates for BOTH arms; first16 dates held cash/no evaluated decisions for both. Existing277 full76 baseline remains an unchanged historical reference. No v1/full76 vs v2/60 mismatch.
cv.finalRefitAfterFutureDevelopment: Only after separately authorized Development evaluation: use fixed3:1 split1–57 fit/58–76 inner calibration to choose one tau by SAME selection rule; then refit one final model on all eligible76 sessions. This final-fit full76 replay is explicitly IN-SAMPLE; not the nested OOF estimate. No tau refit from portfolio outcomes.

crossSymbol.canonicalSymbol: Exact pinned uppercase string from frozen metadata; no sector/PnL sorting or zero stripping
crossSymbol.method: For each outer fold andhash group g, exclude ALL symbols assigned g from inner fit,inner calibration andouter refit. Evaluate only group g in future outer dates. Recombine all5 held-symbol predictions into one timestamp-ordered stream; each event scored exactly once by a model that never trained/selected tau on that symbol.
crossSymbol.emptyGroup: INCONCLUSIVE; no reassigning symbols or targeted LOSO rescue
crossSymbol.topContributorLOSO: Diagnostic only; never primary fold design
crossSymbol.interpretation: Generalization of added Entry component conditional on outcome-exposed Frozen Selector anduniverse; NOT full-stack OOS.

state.latch: First ENTER signal consumes symbol-session Entry eligibility even if allocation rejects purchase. No repeatEntry after exit orcash rejection. SKIP may reconsider only at a fresh frozen Top5 event.
state.noNewTimeFilter: Keep all frozen decision timestamps, including lunch/late-session candidates. Future strict-label censoring never invalidates an Entry signal. Existing cash ledger alone applies NO_REMAINING_REGULAR_BAR from deterministic session calendar.

decision.rule: If inherited frozen decision reference and causal inputs valid, symbol-session not entered andDhat<=tau => ENTER; otherwise SKIP_THIS_DECISION. Censor/outcome availability never a decision input.
decision.generation: Positive severity landmarks already fixed in user P0 cohort definitions; use all4 without interpolation/additions. No threshold fitted ortested in this freeze.
decision.selectionScope: Inner calibration only, or final3:1 calibration; fit statistics come from earlier fit slice.
decision.selectionEligibility: Candidate must have defined own/v1meanD30,ES95,preservation3/5,throughput,precision1/2,coverage. Apply entry-level Primary risk/preservation/throughput andprecision/coverage Guardrails below; portfolio/HHI/cross-symbol gates are NOT used to choose tau.
selectionOrder: then highest all ENTER signal count
decision.noFeasibleThreshold: SELECTION_INCONCLUSIVE_NO_CANDIDATE; no defaulttau, no gate relaxation. Stop that fold/replica; full OOF evaluation incomplete.

metricDefinitions.meanD30: Arithmetic mean max(0,-strict30mMAE) among each arm own first ENTER with complete strict30m. Symbol-macro mean also reported; never common-ENTER-only primary.
metricDefinitions.symbolMacroMeanD30: For each arm separately, compute mean D30 per symbol with at least one complete own ENTER, then average those symbol means with equal weights. Report both symbol lists and their overlap. Missing/zero-entry symbols are NOT assigned zero loss. Require throughput/preservation and coverage guardrails alongside this metric; report common-symbol macro as secondary only.
metricDefinitions.ES95D30: Sort own complete D30 descending; arithmetic mean of worst ceil(0.05*N), minimum1. Not percentile clipping or removal.
metricDefinitions.throughput: All own first ENTER signals / same evaluation sessions; includes unlabelable signals and allocation rejects. Separate portfolio accepted count. First signal consumes symbol-session eligibility.
metricDefinitions.precisionK: Complete strict30m own first ENTER with MFE>=K / complete strict30m own first ENTER. UNKNOWN labels never failures or successes.
metricDefinitions.preservationK: Shared denominator: symbol-sessions whose FIRST frozen Top5 event has complete strict30m MFE>=K. Numerator: own first ENTER before that original30m endpoint AND future HIGH from Entry through original endpoint reaches EntryPrice*(1+K/100), with complete path. Unknown numerator counted0 only in explicit lower-bound metric; report unknown count. This preserves remaining original opportunity, not late same-session admission.
metricDefinitions.preservationTimingNote: At existing30m candidate cadence a later selection normally misses the original window. Same-session admission and new opportunity recovered later are secondary diagnostics, not silently substituted for primary preservation.
metricDefinitions.coverageRate: own complete strict30m ENTER count / own all ENTER count; same denominator scope per arm. missing/late/lunch reasons separately.
metricDefinitions.concentration: Aggregate net cash PnL by accepted symbol; separately normalize positive net contributions and absolute negative net contributions. HHI=sum(shares^2), effective contributors=1/HHI, top1/3/5 shares, median/dispersion. Undefined when sign mass absent; no invented0.
metricDefinitions.portfolio: Frozen observed-close cash replay of own ENTER stream. One initial1mJPY across common gate window, not reset at folds. Reference-price evidence, not executable-fill proof.

numericGates.independentRationale: Predeclared research utility choices: require10% reduction in typical adverse severity; allow at most10% loss of +3/+5 remaining opportunities; allow at most20% fewer Entry signals; tolerate at most10% relative worsening in secondary PF/DD/concentration, with nonnegative net-PnL difference and at least one PF/DD improvement. These are symmetric relative tolerance budgets, not estimates fitted to P0, not statistical significance, and not feasibility promises.5pp coverage imbalance is a separately declared observability tolerance. No absolute threshold derived from known10 tails/HHI/DD/Top3 results.
diagnostics: score bins vs observed D30 and calibration error
Top1/Top3 trade andsymbol removal;Top5 if supported
new recoveries/new rejects by event andsymbol-session
new Entry count/unique symbols/trades per symbol/cash utilization
numericGates.comparisons: All ratios v2 / frozen v1 recomputed on SAME gate window and metric definitions. Cross-symbol ratios use stitched held-symbol v2 OOF vs same frozen v1 predictions; upstream remains outcome-exposed.

applicationScopes.chronological: All Primary keys except symbolDisjoint* and all Guardrails on stitched four chronological outer evaluation blocks. Portfolio and concentration use this same stream.
applicationScopes.symbolDisjoint: symbolDisjoint* Primary keys on stitched held-group predictions. Each of five groups must have defined per-arm mean D30; count groups with ratio<=1. Same entry precision1/2 and coverage guardrails also apply to the pooled held-group stream. Portfolio/concentration for this stream are secondary diagnostics, not a hidden additional gate.
applicationScopes.innerCalibration: Only entry-level meanD30, ES95, preservation3/5 and throughput Primary keys, precision1/2 and coverage Guardrails. No symbol-group, Portfolio or concentration criteria select the threshold.

numericGates.zeroDenominator: No epsilon division. For nonnegative burden metrics baseline0 passes non-worsening only when v2=0; required10% improvement with baseline0 is INCONCLUSIVE. For preservation/throughput baseline0 or absent anchor winners => INCONCLUSIVE. PF=INF comparison only: bothINF meets non-worsening but not improvement; v1INF/v2finite fails PF guard; v2INF/v1finite passes. Undefined HHI/PF/market equity is INCONCLUSIVE, not0.
numericGates.noDataNoPass: Any unpriced open exposure at any required portfolio curve point => portfolio/DD gates INCONCLUSIVE. Missing baseline/candidate metric or unrepresented hash group => INCONCLUSIVE. Existing173 complete-case subset may only support secondary diagnostics, never satisfy primary Portfolio gate.
numericGates.verdictLogic: Future Development PASS only if every Primary and Guardrail passes with all5 hash groups evaluable. Known violation=>FAIL with unknown gates separately shown. Otherwise any unknown=>INCONCLUSIVE. Median/winrate/every individual fold need not improve. No trade collapse, no sacrificing net profit solely to lower concentration.
numericGates.uncertainty: Report session-block and symbol-dependence limitations; these numeric gates are engineering trade-off criteria, not hypothesis-test p-values or independent OOS proof. No IID interpretation.
